action_items.detail: Jump-to-reply pill and 'r' shortcut focus the draft card's '...' (draft-more) button — the first focusable control in the reply area — rather than 'Approve & send'. Inside the reply area, so it meets REQ-973; builder may prefer focusing the primary action.

Channels → Chat: the window does scroll (236px @1920x1080, 494px @1440x900) because the settings column is longer than the viewport. The preview is sticky, though: at 1920 the whole widget (313–1016) and the close launcher stay in view, and at 1440 preview-surface (24–555) scrolls internally (724/531) and stays in view. I counted this as meeting the intent; it does not meet a literal 'no page-level scroll'.
The preview ingress returned HTTP 429 when checks ran in parallel, so the phone/chat check runs on localhost:3000. The desktop JRN-218 check ran through the preview URL.

checks.name: p18-jrn218-phone-chat-fit
checks.evidence: 390x844: draft dock bottom 844 = viewport and stays there after the thread scrolls to top; scrollWidth 390. Chat preview 1920x1080: widget 313–1016 fully in view, sticky when the page scrolls, no horizontal scroll. 1440x900: canvas 120–820 fits, preview-surface scrolls internally 724/531, sticky in view, no horizontal scroll.
